name: José David Cabello
detail: Head of the tax authority (Seniat) in August 2018; said the tax reform of that month (VAT from 12% to 16%, higher financial transactions tax, advance payments) was aimed at "ricos" and special taxpayers. These are consumption, transaction and income measures, not a tax on net wealth.

name: Impuesto a las Grandes Transacciones Financieras (IGTF)
detail: Tax on large financial transactions (the 2018 increase to 1%, later extended to payments in foreign currency); a transaction tax, not a wealth tax. Anyone who defends it is not recorded.
